name: grievance
description: AI-powered grievance management system using NLP/ML for multilingual complaint translation, DistilBERT classification, urgency detection, and MiniLM similarity analysis. Built with Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, and JWT. Dockerized locally and deployed on Azure Containers. Archived; live demo available.

paragraphs: An AI-powered grievance management system that automates complaint handling using NLP and machine learning. The system accepts multilingual complaints, translates them when required, classifies them using DistilBERT, detects urgency, identifies similar issues using MiniLM embeddings, and routes complaints to the appropriate department.

Project Status: Archived / Development Concluded The original implementation has been preserved in its existing state and is presented as a completed project. The deployed application remains available as a live demonstration.
features: Users can submit complaints in different languages.
The processing layer detects the language and translates the complaint into English when required.
The translated complaint is passed to a DistilBERT-based classification layer.
The system uses a lightweight hybrid approach for identifying urgency.
